formatTime.value: (iso) => { if (!iso) return ''; var d = new Date(iso); var pad = function(n) { return String(n).padStart(2, '0'); }; return d.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad(d.getDate()) + ' ' + pad(d.getHours()) + ':' + pad(d.getMinutes()); }

loadStats.value: async () => { try { console.log('[JSON DEBUG] loadStats called'); const res = await window.__VTJ_AUTH__.apiFetch('/api/notes/stats', { headers: this.getJsonHeaders() }); console.log('[JSON DEBUG] stats status:', res.status); if (res.ok) { const d = await res.json(); console.log('[JSON DEBUG] stats data:', JSON.stringify(d)); this.state.stats = d; } } catch(e) { console.log('[JSON DEBUG] stats error:', e.message); } }

loadNotes.value: async () => { this.state.loading = true; try { var url = '/api/notes/' + this.state.activeTab + '?page=' + this.state.page + '&page_size=' + this.state.pageSize; console.log('[JSON DEBUG] loadNotes url:', url, 'activeTab:', this.state.activeTab); const res = await window.__VTJ_AUTH__.apiFetch(url, { headers: this.getJsonHeaders() }); console.log('[JSON DEBUG] notes status:', res.status, 'ok:', res.ok); if (res.ok) { const data = await res.json(); console.log('[JSON DEBUG] notes total:', data.total, 'items:', (data.items||[]).length); this.state.total = data.total || 0; if (this.state.activeTab === 'news') { this.state.newsNotes = data.items || []; console.log('[JSON DEBUG] newsNotes len:', this.state.newsNotes.length); } else { this.state.questionNotes = data.items || []; console.log('[JSON DEBUG] questionNotes len:', this.state.questionNotes.length); } } } catch(e) { console.log('[JSON DEBUG] loadNotes error:', e.message); } finally { this.state.loading = false; } }
